| Host | Publish storage on several machines | [`vastai list volumes`](/cli/reference/list-volumes) |
| Host | Stop advertising a volume offer | [`vastai unlist volume`](/cli/reference/unlist-volume) |
| Renter | Find volume offers | [`vastai search volumes`](/cli/reference/search-volumes) |
| Renter | Create an owned volume from an offer | [`vastai create volume`](/cli/reference/create-volume) |
| Renter | Inspect owned volumes | [`vastai show volumes`](/cli/reference/show-volumes) |
| Renter | Link a new or existing volume to a container | [`vastai create instance`](/cli/reference/create-instance) |

claims.text: Separate "listed" from "visible in a normal broad search." Marketplace search is not a complete inventory dump. notified and can save their work.
